chunks: Those who left their homes in the way of God, and then were killed or died, will surely be given a better provision by God, for God is surely the best of providers.
ai.seo_question: What is the reward for those who emigrate in the way of God and are killed or die?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Hajj is often linked to the Muhajirun of the Prophet and the Ahl al-Bayt, emphasizing that their migration (Hijra) was not merely physical but a spiritual struggle for divine truth. The 'generous provision' (rizqan hasan) is interpreted as both spiritual elevation in this life and abundant reward in the Hereafter, affirming God's role as the ultimate sustainer of those who sacrifice for His cause.
